keywords: how many application do you have
answer:
Our optical metrology systems are used across multiple industries. Here are our 4 main applications:

1. [Head-Up Display Test with OMI](/applications?app=head-up-display-test) - Production line testing of automotive Heads-Up Displays (HUD) using the OMI sensor and SenSoft software.
2. [Testing Lenses with Optino: Measure Stress Due to Lens Mounting](/applications?app=optino-lens-stress-test) - Evaluate stress-induced aberrations and wavefront deformations in ophthalmic lenses caused by mounting or clamping.
3. [Astronomical Telescope Test with Puntino: Measure Stress Due to Supports](/applications?app=telescope-mirror-test) - Analyze large telescope mirrors with annular pupils to measure surface stress and wavefront deformations due to supports.
4. [Digital Camera Lens Test: On-Axis and Off-Axis Test](/applications?app=digital-camera-lens-test) - On-axis and off-axis testing of digital camera lenses and microscope objectives to analyze aberrations, wavefront, and MTF.
